translations.web: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
translations.bsb: At the sacrifice I am preparing, you will eat fat until you are gorged and drink blood until you are drunk.
translations.kjv: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed
translations.asv: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
